outcome: Planned birth (caesarean delivery or induction of labour)
cohort: Female residents of New South Wales, Australia aged 15-45 years and their index singleton pregnancy of at least 20 weeks gestation or 400 g birthweight (n=578,221)
finding: Endometriosis and ART use were both associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, antepartum haemorrhage, placenta praevia and planned birth.
mod_finding: Planned birth, which includes caesarean delivery, was increased in women with endometriosis and/or ART use.
